main.description: Groups variant listings and declares their option axes. Source of truth for the product-level facts its variants inherit. Holds no availability of its own — group availability is derived from its children by AppViews.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the parent shop record

defaultVariant.description: AT URI of the variant listing a product page should open on. Must be a listing whose partOf is this group; one belonging to another group renders as a confusing page rather than an obvious failure.

optionAxes.description: Variant axes declared on this group (e.g. Color, Size)

category.description: Coarse category for every variant in this group. Inherited by variant listings.

fulfillmentKind.description: Delivery kind for every variant in this group. Inherited by variant listings.

classifications.description: Detailed classification in external taxonomies. Inherited by variant listings.

specifications.description: Structured product properties shared by every variant. Inherited by variant listings.

identifiers.description: Identifiers that apply to the product as a whole. Variant-specific identifiers (a per-variant GTIN) belong on the variant listing and are not inherited.

images.description: Inherited by variant listings that carry no images of their own.
